State/schema tests reject stale/mismatched/partial reports and distinguish acceptance, turn completion and evidence verification. Migration/backup approach preserves existing project state. No new paid orchestration layer.

Real-file fixtures and synthetic cases cover headings in fenced code, multiple prefixes, shared rules, Unicode/spaced paths, missing dependencies and reimports. Preview text matches what will be submitted. Importing/selecting does not create a thread, invoke a model or execute imported instructions.

Fake runtime proves three prompts run in order in distinct threads, with one accepted send per dispatch and no extra task afterward. Duplicate events, double Start, response loss, concurrent UI/manual dispatch and restart do not duplicate work. A busy native workflow or uncertain active turn prevents another mutating task.

Third no-progress attempt, dependent/independent branches, stale evidence, native request still holding a turn, malformed report, human-only check, expired/duplicate answer and explicit skip all have correct outcomes. Unanswered required work is never complete. Reports distinguish all verified from finished with blockers.

Native Windows/fixture tests cover stop races, view/thread switches, minimize/restore, sleep recovery, close confirmation, power-request cleanup and late usage. UI operations make zero inference calls. Keyboard/fullscreen/200% layouts retain the controls.

Every matrix row has evidence or a precise blocker; no duplicate model effects, lost attempts or false task completion. Runner tests work without development-only paths in the recipient package. The feature is not called fully qualified if native/reply tests remain unavailable.

Comparable before/after measurements and relevant regression checks; no loss of features, accessibility or inference parity. Report current target pass/miss with practical remaining options. If still above target, retain the performance criterion open pending repair or an explicit release exception. CPU and long-history interaction are also measured.

Required native/human observations have real evidence; otherwise retain exact unverified criteria and a short checklist with expected results. Do not claim Narrator passed from DOM attributes or physical DPI passed from emulated zoom. Fix observed defects and rerun affected paths.

Required checks on the actual candidate pass or remain explicit release blockers. No claimed Windows-native result is supported only by a foreign host/mock. Original and enhancement ledgers agree about completed, stale, partial and blocked work.

Modern-menu invocation is observed under the declared trust state. Test trust is not production distribution. Failed trust/registration remains MONA-027 blocked; classic success does not close it. Installer/uninstaller remove only their own registration.

Local/test candidate has a demonstrable recipient installation path and lifecycle evidence on its actual bytes. W22 signing/trust or licensing gaps remain explicit release gates; do not call an untrusted package frictionless friend-ready distribution. Installer work can complete without pretending those external decisions are made.

Actual packaged timings/workflows and artifact identity are recorded. A development smoke or a source checkout is not substituted. Signed-distribution readiness is claimed only for the final validated package and resolved mandatory gates; full 1.0 still requires the original complete scope.

Every task accounted for; docs match behavior; no falsely green requirement; no leaked secrets; the next session can resume without rediscovering context. A closure prompt may finish with an accurate blocked-task report; it does not mark the blocked tasks complete.
